review_candidates.title: Video Annotator
review_candidates.description: Location: Fully Remote Schedule: Full-Time, Remote Check out The Global Talent Co.’s talent network: https://www.globaltalent.co/network About The Role We are looking for detail-oriented Video Annotators to support a Vision-Language-Action (VLA) dataset project. In this role, you will watch short video clips of physical tasks/activities and produce event-level annotations by segmenting each video into meaningful steps and writing clear, precise natural-language instructions describing the action taking place in each segment. Key Responsibilities Watch assigned videos in full before beginning annotation to understand the overall task and context. Segment each video into discrete, logical steps/events based on visible action boundaries. Write clear, concise, and grammatically correct step-by-step descriptions for each segment, accurately reflecting what is happening on screen. Ensure annotations are action-oriented, unambiguous, and consistent in tense, tone, and phrasing across the dataset. Assign accurate start and end timestamps for each segment. Follow annotation guidelines, taxonomies, and style guides provided by the project team. Flag videos that are unclear, corrupted, mislabeled, or otherwise unsuitable for annotation. Participate in calibration sessions and incorporate reviewer/QA feedback to improve annotation quality and consistency. Meet daily/weekly productivity and quality targets without compromising accuracy. Maintain confidentiality of all project data and materials. Required Qualifications English Proficiency: C1 level (CEFR) or above — strong command of grammar, vocabulary, and sentence construction is essential. Excellent attention to detail and ability to spot subtle changes in visual scenes. Strong written communication skills; ability to describe actions concisely and precisely. Comfort working with video-based tools and annotation software (training provided). Ability to work independently, follow detailed guidelines, and maintain consistency over repetitive tasks. Reliable internet connection and access to a computer with a modern browser. Basic computer literacy (file handling, web-based tools, spreadsheets). Preferred Qualifications Prior experience in data annotation, labeling, transcription, or content moderation. Familiarity with AI/ML concepts, especially computer vision, NLP, or robotics datasets. Experience writing instructional or procedural content (how-to guides, SOPs, recipes). Exposure to annotation platforms (e.g., CVAT, Label Studio, Scale, or similar tools). At The Global Talent Co., our mission is to bridge the gap between leading global brands and amazing global talent. We believe everyone deserves equal access to opportunities, regardless of the country they are born in.

review_candidates.title: Specialist – HR System & Data
review_candidates.location: Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates
review_candidates.description: JOB PURPOSE/SUMMARY: To administer, support, and continuously improve the organization’s HR systems and workforce data environment, with primary responsibility for ERP HCM platforms. The role ensures reliable, accurate and secure employee data, effective reporting and analytics, controlled system changes, and seamless integration between HR and other applications. The role works closely with HR process owners, Information Technology, Finance, external vendors, and business stakeholders to translate operational requirements into effective system solutions, strengthen data governance, and enable informed workforce decision-making. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES AND ACCOUNTABILITIES 1.HR System Administration and Operational Support Administer and provide functional support for Oracle and/or SAP HR modules, including payroll-related data, absence, performance, recruitment, learning, and employee self-service, workflows, approval in accordance with approved HR policies and processes. Provide the first line support to Investigate user incidents, determine root causes, and coordinate resolution with Information Technology, vendors, and relevant HR teams. Maintain an organized log of incidents, service requests, system defects, resolutions, and recurring issues. Provide functional guidance and timely support to HR users, employees, and managers. Develop user guides, process documentation, frequently asked questions, and system support materials. 2.HR Data Management and Governance Maintain the accuracy and perform regular data-quality reviews, completeness, consistency, and integrity of employee, position, organization, and other workforce data across HR systems. Establish and maintain HR data definitions, validation rules, coding standards, ownership requirements, and data-maintenance procedures. Coordinate data cleansing, migration, conversion, and validation activities during system implementations, upgrades, and organizational changes. Support the maintenance of organizational structures, positions, reporting lines, job information, grades, cost centres, and workforce records within the system. 3.Dashboards, Reporting, Analytics and Information Management Work with HR stakeholders to clarify reporting requirements and translate them into practical dashboards, reports, and data solutions. Develop and maintain standard and ad hoc HR reports, dashboards, and workforce data extracts using Power BI, ERP, or approved business-intelligence tools. Provide accurate and timely workforce information covering headcount, turnover, vacancies, Emiratization, absence, employee movement, demographics, performance, and other HR indicators. Validate reports against source-system records and reconcile discrepancies before information is released. 4.System Enhancement, Testing and Integration – 15% Analyse, and document HR requirements for enhancements, automation, integrations, and initiatives. Translate business requirements into functional specifications, process maps, configuration requirements. Participate in system implementations, upgrades, and integration projects involving HCM, payroll, recruitment, performance, learning, time-management, finance, and other enterprise systems. Prepare and execute functional testing, system integration testing, and user-acceptance testing. Document test results, identify defects, coordinate corrective actions, and verify resolution. Coordinate with Information Technology and vendors to ensure accurate and secure data exchange between integrated systems. Support change implementation, user communications, training, and post-go-live stabilization. Identify opportunities to simplify HR processes, reduce manual transactions, improve employee experience, and increase the use of automation and self-service. 5.Security, Controls, Compliance and Documentation Support the administration and periodic review of HR system access, user roles, approval authorities, and segregation-of-duties controls. Ensure system access is granted, amended, and removed based on approved requests and assigned responsibilities. Support internal and external audits by providing system records, data extracts, evidence, and responses. Monitor compliance with applicable HR policies, information-security requirements, data-privacy. Escalate material system, data, access, integration, or compliance risks to the Senior Director – HR. Track agreed corrective actions arising from audits, data reviews, access reviews, or assessments. 4. QUALIFICATIONS, EXPERIENCE AND COMPETENCIES Minimum Qualifications: (Education/Certification/ Licensure/Professional Membership) Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Management Information Systems, Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, Data Analytics, or a related discipline. One or more of the following would be advantageous: Oracle HCM Cloud or Oracle E-Business Suite certification. IFS / SAP SuccessFactors or SAP HCM certification. HR analytics or data-management certification. Business analysis, project management, or IT service-management certification. Power BI, SQL, or other reporting and analytics certification. Minimum Experience: 5 years of relevant experience in HR systems, HR data management, HR reporting, or HR technology. At least three years of hands-on functional experience with IFS, Oracle HCM, Oracle E-Business Suite, SAP HCM, and/or SAP SuccessFactors. Experience supporting HR system implementation, configuration, testing, upgrades, integrations, or data-migration activities. Experience preparing workforce reports, dashboards, data reconciliations, and management information, system access controls, and audit requirements. Aviation, engineering, manufacturing, MRO, or another regulated-industry background would be advantageous. Job Specific Competencies: 1. HR Systems and Digital Enablement • Demonstrates strong functional understanding of HR technologies, particularly IFS, Oracle and/or SAP, and applies this knowledge to support operations, configure solutions, automate processes, improve system usability, and enhance the employee and manager experience. 2. Data Governance and Analytical Thinking • Maintains accurate, complete, consistent, and secure HR data. Analyses workforce information systematically, identifies trends and discrepancies, and converts data into reliable insights that support management decision-making. 3. Accuracy and Attention to Detail • Completes system transactions, configurations, reports, testing, and documentation with a high level of precision. Carefully verifies information, detects inconsistencies, and corrects errors before they affect employees, payroll, reporting, or business operations. 4. Problem-Solving and Root-Cause Analysis • Investigates system, process, and data issues logically to identify their underlying causes. Develops practical and sustainable solutions, evaluates potential impacts, and takes appropriate corrective or preventive action. 5. Customer and Employee Service Orientation • Responds promptly and professionally to system users and HR stakeholders. Understands their requirements, provides clear guidance, manages expectations, and delivers solutions that are practical, user-friendly, and aligned with approved policies and processes. 6. Collaboration and Stakeholder Management • Builds effective working relationships with HR teams, Information Technology, Finance, system vendors, managers, and other stakeholders. Communicates requirements clearly, coordinates activities, and facilitates agreement on system, data, and process solutions. 7. Planning, Organization and Delivery • Prioritizes and manages multiple operational requests, reports, testing activities, system changes, and projects effectively. Meets agreed deadlines, follows through on commitments, and maintains proper documentation and progress tracking. 8. Confidentiality, Integrity and Accountability • Handles employee and organizational data with discretion and in accordance with applicable policies, access controls, and data-privacy requirements. Takes ownership of assigned responsibilities, acts ethically, and promptly escalates errors, risks, or control concerns.

As a Service Technician, our entry level role, you will support inspections, maintenance, and repair tasks across both MacGregor and third-party systems, including cranes, winches, hatch covers, steering gears and RoRo equipment. Working under the guidance and direct mentorship of Senior Engineers, you will concentrate on carrying out routine preventive maintenance and get to know our equipment. This role requires extensive European travel to client sites, shipyards, and vessels. Given our global client base, high flexibility is essential. Our office is in Trieste for local assignments, so living within reach is required. What You’ll Be Doing Perform supervised service activities such as refurbishment, upgrades, inspections, preventative maintenance and corrective actions Hands-on work with mechanical, hydraulic and electrical systems Working from technical drawings and manuals and using standard tools and diagnostic equipment Preparing service reports and other documentation Working closely with experienced engineers and colleagues across MacGregor’s European service network Ensure that all activities comply with the Integrated Management System (IMS), QHSE and other rules and requirements according to MacGregor standards Who are we looking for? We welcome applicants who are in the beginning of their career from a variety of technical backgrounds, including mechanical maintenance, electrical work, hydraulics, industrial equipment, shipyards, manufacturing, automotive, or heavy machinery. Seeking motivated, hands-on individuals who are eager to learn, travel, and build a long-term career in an international company. Do you have a technical education and practical background in mechanical, electrical, or hydraulic systems? This role is a great step stone. Ideally, You Have An apprenticeship, technical diploma or degree in mechanical, electrical, hydraulic or another relevant technical field Up to 2 years of hands-on technical experience Basic ability to read technical drawings and manuals Ability to use standard hand tools, precision measuring instruments, and basic diagnostic equipment A practical mindset and willingness to learn Proficient English skills for effective on-site communication and reporting Must hold a valid driving licence Willingness and adaptability to travel extensively throughout Europe, including multi-week and overnight trips Why MacGregor? Joining the newly established Trieste Service Hub offers a unique opportunity to grow with a new team, influence hub operations, work on complex and innovating equipment, gain global experience, and build expertise via MacGregor Academy. Our people are behind every success. People create the technology and product lifecycle solutions that make us great, our people are the ones who innovate, and people drive our business forward. With us you will be part of an international collaborative working culture with challenges and opportunities to further develop yourself professionally. MacGregor is an equal opportunity employer. Additionally, We Offer Permanent, full-time employment €35,000–€38,000 gross annual base salary, depending on experience and skills Daily travel allowance when working away from base Welfare vouchers and food vouchers Professional technical training and development International exposure and career opportunities Ready for your next challenge? If you are ready to step into an exciting new role where you can make a significant impact and contribute to the success of our new Service hub, apply today! Please submit your CV/application in English . www.macgregor.com
